name: Tsukishiro Yoshiya
source:
An overprotective older brother who will do anything to achieve his goal.

He is the president of the large company, Tsukishiro Group. He enjoys teasing people, making it difficult to discern his true thoughts. As the owner of L&L and Chigaya’s biological brother, he is quite overprotective of his younger sibling, supporting him in every way.
